SCE.S:2BC854: My school friend. Does "space-time" research on his father's money. The government watches it.
SCE.S:2BCDE8: Worked 43 years here until the warehouse closed. Bedridden for 10 years, the "anomaly" healed him; he came back.
SCE.S:2BD778: Third agent sent to look into the City. Trailing his predecessor to the hospital, he was "treated" and sent here.
SCE.S:2BD844: Tax man Sugimura came to audit the warehouse, fused with old machinery, and wrote a new page in life's history.
